name: Eka Pratama
title: QA Engineer / System Analyst
summary: QA Engineer with 4+ years of experience in manual testing, API testing, and web automation. Proficient in designing test plans, writing test cases, API automation using Postman/REST, and database validation with SQL. Passionate about ensuring software quality across fintech and SaaS platforms.

bullets: Designed and executed 250+ manual and automated test cases for fintech core banking and payment services.
Implemented API automated tests using Postman and Newman, integrating into CI/CD pipeline to catch regressions early.
Conducted end-to-end browser regression automation using Playwright, reducing release regression testing time by 40%.
Collaborated with developers and product managers to clarify user stories and acceptance criteria in agile sprints.
Authored Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) and created Test Case Documents for ERP and CRM applications.
Performed SQL queries to validate backend transactions and data integrity during database migrations.
Logged and tracked defects using JIRA, communicating root cause analyses to engineering teams.
